criteria.directAnswer: States the answer directly and simply.
criteria.stepByStep: Walks through a sequence of steps.
criteria.conditional: The answer depends on a stated condition, e.g. "it depends on...".
criteria.redirect: Points the reader elsewhere rather than answering directly here.
